# polygons.library: RingWithoutCollinearVertices

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> The ring with every flat vertex dropped, ONE AT A TIME.
>
> Removing them in a single sweep is wrong, and wrong in a way that quietly changes
> the region: a vertex that appears twice has zero turn at both copies — once from
> the collinear run it sits in, once from the repeat — so a sweep deletes the corner
> outright rather than reducing it to one vertex. Removing the first flat vertex and
> re-examining is O(n^2) and correct, and correct wins here (STYLE\_GUIDE.md).
> Terminates because every step shortens the ring.

```plato

    // The ring with every flat vertex dropped, ONE AT A TIME.
    //
    // Removing them in a single sweep is wrong, and wrong in a way that quietly changes
    // the region: a vertex that appears twice has zero turn at both copies — once from
    // the collinear run it sits in, once from the repeat — so a sweep deletes the corner
    // outright rather than reducing it to one vertex. Removing the first flat vertex and
    // re-examining is O(n^2) and correct, and correct wins here (STYLE_GUIDE.md).
    // Terminates because every step shortens the ring.
    RingWithoutCollinearVertices(points: Array<Point2D>): Array<Point2D>
    {
        var result = points;
        var flat = result.FirstFlatVertex;
        while (flat >= 0)
        {
            result = result.RingWithout(flat);
            flat = result.FirstFlatVertex;
        }
        return result;
    }
```
